children: On September 10, TradingBeats, formerly Hyperinsight, reported that a smart money trader opened a 25x leveraged long position in HYPE worth $2.1 million at an average entry price of $83.81, with a liquidation price of $72.36. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the trader's historical record shows total lifetime profits of $9.29 million.

title: Smart Money Opens 25x Leveraged HYPE Long Position as Lifetime Profit Reaches $9.29 Million
